panels.description: Number of transactions started.
panels.title: Transactions Started

panels.description: Number of transactions committed.
panels.title: Transactions Committed

panels.description: Number of transactions aborted.
panels.title: Transactions Aborted

panels.description: Number of transactions aborted. (This value may be greater than the sum of TransCommitCount and TransAbortCount.)
panels.title: Transactions Closed

panels.description: Number of operations based on or using primary keys. This count includes blob-part table operations, implicit unlocking operations, and auto-increment operations, as well as primary key operations normally visible to MySQL clients.
panels.title: Primary Key Operations

panels.description: Number of operations based on or using unique keys.
panels.title: Unique Key Operations

panels.description: Amount of data (in bytes) sent to the data nodes.
panels.title: Bytes Sent To Data Nodes

panels.description: Amount of data (in bytes) received from the data nodes.
panels.title: Bytes Received From Data Nodes

panels.description: Number of times thread has been blocked while waiting for execution of an operation to complete. Includes all execute() calls as well as implicit executes for blob operations and auto-increment not visible to clients.
panels.title: Wait Exec Complete Count

panels.description: Number of times thread has been blocked while waiting for a scan-based signal, such waiting for additional results, or for a scan to close.
panels.title: Wait Scan Result Count

panels.description: Number of times thread has been blocked waiting for a metadata-based signal; this can occur when waiting for a DDL operation or for an epoch to be started (or ended).
panels.title: Wait Meta Request Count

panels.description: Total time (in nanoseconds) spent waiting for some type of signal from the data nodes.
panels.title: Total Signal Wait Duration

panels.description: Number of table scans that have been started. This includes scans of internal tables.
panels.title: Table Scans

panels.description: Number of range scans that have been started.
panels.title: Range Scans

panels.description: Number of scans that have been pruned to a single partition.
panels.title: Pruned Scans

panels.description: Number of batches of rows received. (A batch in this context is a set of scan results from a single fragment.)
panels.title: Batch Scans

panels.description: Total number of rows that have been read. Includes rows read using primary key, unique key, and scan operations.
panels.title: Read Rows

panels.description: Number of rows read from the data same node on which the transaction was being run.
panels.title: Transaction Local Read Rows

panels.description: Number of row change events received.
panels.title: Received Data Events

panels.description: Number of events received, other than row change events.
panels.title: Received Non-Data Events

panels.description: Number of bytes of events received.
panels.title: Bytes Of Events

panels.description: Number of row change events received.
panels.title: Received Data Events (Binary Log Injector)

panels.description: Number of events received, other than row change events.
panels.title: Received Non-Data Events (Binary Log Injector)

panels.description: Number of bytes of events received.
panels.title: Bytes Of Events (Binary Log Injector)

panels.description: Number of adaptive send calls that were not actually sent.
panels.title: Adaptive Send Deferred Count

panels.description: Number of adaptive send calls using forced-send sent by this MySQL Server (SQL node).
panels.title: Adaptive Send Forced Count

panels.description: Number of adaptive send calls without forced-send sent by this MySQL server (SQL node).
panels.title: Adaptive Send Unforced Count
